name: Arboliva
description: Arboliva, the Olive Pokémon, and the evolved form of Dolliv. A Grass and Normal type.
pokedex_entries: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.
